title: Open-source alternative to Grok Bot, dots, Duet, Tag and Muse
description: pi-durable-bot (Pots) is the open-source alternative to Grok Bot, OpenAI dots, Claude Duet, Claude Tag and Meta Muse. Each comparison lists its sources.
claim: The open-source Grok Bot alternative: an AI coworker that acts on its own. Each page puts pi-durable-bot (Pots) next to one product, with sources.

cards.line: AI teammates on the maker's cloud; the maker picks the model.
Always-on agents, one per person, in ChatGPT, Slack and Teams.
A proactive agent in its own app; a US-only preview.
Claude in Slack; it also reads untagged messages.
A personal agent in its own app and in WhatsApp.

note: Each page compares the same six rows, from the makers' own pages, and links them. To be fair: all five also have a cloud computer or sandbox, memory and scheduled work. The other products as their makers described them in public, checked 2026-11-10; they may have changed since. Grok Bot, dots, Claude Duet, Claude Tag and Muse are products of SpaceXSI, OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta. pi-durable-bot is not affiliated with any of them.
